articles.title: Pump.fun bounty platform pays users to tattoo tokens and chase viral stunts
articles.snippet: Pump.fun launched a new bounty platform where users started funding bizarre memecoin marketing stunts, including forehead tattoos, skydiving as a mascot and setting a vehicle on fire.

articles.title: Pump.fun's Latest Experiment Is Already Getting Weird
articles.snippet: Pump.fun's GO bounty platform already has hundreds of listings following its pitch to let users “Pay ANYONE to do ANYTHING.”
